text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) can cause common side effects like increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections, as well as serious risks such as diabetic ketoacidosis and dehydration.
snippet_highlighted_words: increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections

list.snippet: Increased urination: Frequent or urgent need to pee as the medication clears excess sugar from your blood through your urine. Taking your dose in the morning can help reduce nighttime trips to the bathroom.
Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Burning, pain, urgency, or abnormal urine appearance.
Genital yeast infections: Fungal infections causing vaginal itching, burning, pain, or thick white discharge in women, and redness, irritation, or swelling around the penis or scrotum in men.
Increased thirst and weight loss: Mild fluid loss and metabolic changes can trigger extra thirst or modest changes in weight.

text_blocks.snippet: Seek prompt medical attention or contact your healthcare provider if you notice signs of severe reactions:

list.snippet: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA): A life-threatening buildup of acid in the blood (which can happen even with normal blood sugar levels). Symptoms include fruity-smelling breath, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, extreme fatigue, and trouble breathing.

Dehydration and low blood pressure: Loss of water and salt can cause dizziness, lightheadedness, weakness, or fainting, especially when standing up. Risk is higher if you are over 65, have kidney issues, or take water pills (diuretics).
Severe kidney or urinary infections: Pyelonephritis or urosepsis, marked by high fever, chills, lower back or side pain, and bloody or cloudy urine.
Low blood sugar (Hypoglycemia): More likely if Jardiance is combined with insulin or sulfonylureas, causing shaking, sweating, fast heartbeat, or confusion.
Necrotizing fasciitis (Fournier's gangrene): A rare, severe, and life-threatening bacterial infection of the perineum (area between the genitals and anus) causing intense pain, swelling, and fever.
Lower limb amputations: An increased risk of toe or leg amputation has been observed, particularly in patients with pre-existing vascular disease or foot ulcers.
Serious allergic reactions: Swelling of the face, lips, or throat, hives, and difficulty breathing or swallowing.

text_blocks.snippet: For full prescribing details and safety warnings, review the official guide from Boehringer Ingelheim or consult a pharmacist or doctor.
